presets.notes: For accounts initiated from orders created on or after 12 October 2026 (FTMO's 8 October trading update gives the cut-over as Monday 12 October 2026, 9:00 platform time, GMT+3), or accounts merged on or after that date. FTMO's Consistency rule: your Best Day — the single day with the highest profit from closed trades — may not represent more than 50% of your total profit, which FTMO defines as 'the cumulative sum of closed profits and losses across all trading days', so losing days count against you. Exceeding the limit is not a rule breach; you continue trading until the best day is 50% or less of total profit. The calculator derives total profit from the account size, your day-start balance and today's closed trades — which assumes no deposits or withdrawals on the account, as on a Challenge account. Accounts from orders created before 12 October 2026 keep the Best Day Rule on Positive Days' Profit — use the '1-Step (orders before 12 Oct 2026)' calculator. FTMO's pages list no minimum-trading-days objective for the 1-Step (the 4-day rule is stated for the 2-Step phases).
